classification.difficultyReason: The percentage must be reversed to find a whole group, then the ratio gives the other group or the total. Two linked procedures with a representation switch.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
At an animal shelter, the ratio of cats to dogs is $3:7$.
15 cats, which is 25% of the number of cats at the shelter, are adopted this week.
How many dogs are at the shelter?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}25\%\text{ of the cats}&=15\text{ cats}\\1\%\text{ of the cats}&=15\div25=0.6\text{ cats}\\100\%\text{ of the cats}&=0.6\times100=60\text{ cats}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=60\text{ animals}\\1\text{ part}&=60\div3=20\text{ animals}\\7\text{ parts}&=7\times20=140\text{ animals}\end{align*}$$
There are 140 dogs.

children.label: b
children.prompt:
The ratio of senior to junior players at a netball club is $5:3$.
18 senior players, which is 40% of the senior players, are selected for the state carnival.
How many players are in the club?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}40\%\text{ of the seniors}&=18\text{ players}\\1\%\text{ of the seniors}&=18\div40=0.45\text{ players}\\100\%\text{ of the seniors}&=0.45\times100=45\text{ players}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}5\text{ parts}&=45\text{ players}\\1\text{ part}&=45\div5=9\text{ players}\\\text{Total parts}&=5+3=8\\8\text{ parts}&=8\times9=72\text{ players}\end{align*}$$
There are 72 players in the club.
